metadata.description: Plugins for Claude Code and GitHub Copilot: my-react (React/TS contract flow + driver agents), my-flutter (Flutter/Dart rules + skills), my-workflow (language-agnostic spec-driven workflow run by a small agent team). Install any subset with setup.py.

plugins.name: my-react
plugins.description: React/TS spec-driven workflow: driver-embedded phase process, contract skills, atlas auditor, driver + worker agents.

plugins.name: my-flutter
plugins.description: Flutter/Dart spec-driven skills: AC authoring, architecture design (P1–P8), Riverpod, test quality, PR review.

plugins.name: my-workflow
plugins.description: Language-agnostic spec-driven workflow: drive-spec leads a task in your session with spec-architect, spec-tester, spec-implementer and spec-reviewer; every other skill does one step alone: rephrase, audit-truth, decide, build, verify, critique; code-auditor builds a codebase atlas. Adapts to how much you specify; uses your installed stack knowledge.
